_about: generated by scripts/skill_health.py --overrides; integrate copies skillOverrides into settings.template.json; values emitted: on | name-only (never user-invocable-only, which hides a skill from the model); plugin skills cannot be overridden

name-only: every invoke-* skill (the model calls them through Skill(); user-invocable-only would hide them)
NAME_ONLY_STATIC list + never-invoked dmi skills when the window holds >= 10 sessions
policy.never: user-invocable-only (it hides the skill from the model's Skill tool)
